root.markdown:
---
# Pure Whirlwind Damage
---

This build will be running on a **Dual Wield** set up. That means both your *One-handed* weapons will be selected for **Whirlwind**. You will need to have one *Sword* and one *Mace* in order to take advantage of your *Skill Points*.

- **If you would like to learn how to set your weapon selection watch this video:** [How to Select Weapons](https://youtu.be/dUuG2CJyAvQ?si=Lz-LY5MK3EehP_CC)

---
## Defense
--- 

**If you want to learn how to set your defenses up, watch this video:** [How to avoid getting one-shot](https://youtu.be/5IrPJ-H_uLI?si=yDaUSCn8owx0mDWj)

---
## Offense
---
- **Whirlwind** will be your main source of damage with this build. 
- *Many sources of your damage will rely on having a lot of resource generation.*
- *Resource Generators*: **Rallying Cry**, **Wrath of the Berserker**, **Wrath Glyph**, 
*Aspects that run off Fury*
- **Edgemaster's** gives you more damage based on how much *Fury* you have when you *Cast a Skill*. This means it has to be a skill where you press a button, not an ability that procs off something i.e.**Dust Devils**.
- **Conceited Aspect** gives you increased damage while you have a **Barrier**. We will be getting **Barrier** from **Iron Skin**. 
- **Vehement Brawler Aspect** gives you damage whenever you Cast your ultimate skill. 
- **Aspect of Dire Whirlwind** will give you additional **Critical Hit Chance** and **Critical Strike Damage** as long as you are *Channeling* **Whirlwind**. 
- **Aspect of Earthquakes** will give you additional damage for your **Whirlwind** when you stand inside of an *Earthquake* and for 4 seconds after you leave that *Earthquake*. With **Igni** sometimes the *Earthquake* will not be underneath you, so you'll need to **Whirlwind** over the *Earthquake* to gain your buff. 

**If you want to learn the basics about Multipliers watch this video:** [Additive vs. Multiplicative Damage](https://youtu.be/xkaKBMKqPcs?si=kDEk0cc_up4pfUKj).

---
## Defense
--- 

**If you want to learn how to set your defenses up, watch this video:** [How to avoid getting one-shot](https://youtu.be/5IrPJ-H_uLI?si=yDaUSCn8owx0mDWj)

---
## Rune Combinations
---

### Overworld Content (Nightmare Dungeons, Helltides, Hordes e.t.c)
- **Bac** + **Lum** 
- **Igni** + **Tec**
### Pit Pushing Runes
- **Bac** + **Tec**
- **Igni** + **Thul**

---
## Uniques
---

- **Gohr's Devastating Grips** will make **Whirlwind** explode every three second. This is reduced by .2 second every time **Whirlwind** lands a *Critical Strike*. With enough *Attack Speed* and *Critical Hit Chance* you can explode and gain extra damage every one second, instead of three. 
- **Tibult's Will** is both *offensive* and *defensive* at the same time. It does provide *Damage Reduction* as well as the *Unique Aspect* gives you increased damage whenever you become **Unstoppable**. You'll gain the **Unstoppable** buff from **Wrath of the Berserker**, **Iron Skin** and **Rallying Cry**. This damage increase lasts for the entire duration of your **Unstoppable** buff, and then stays active for 5 seconds after. This also restores 50 *Fury* every time you use it while you are *NOT* **Unstoppable**. If you are already **Unstoppable** and you use and ability that grants **Unstoppable** it does not restore and *Fury*. 
- **Ramaladni's Magnum Opus** is an incredibly strong *unique* if build correctly. It increases your damage by up to .5% per point of *Fury you have*. The *Unique Aspect* is the most important part of this weapon, followed by the **Maximum Resources**. On build that get close to 400 *Fury* this weapon offers 200% increased damage. 
- **Rage of Harogath** has a chance to reset your *Cooldowns* every time you apply *Bleed* from **Whirlwind**. 

---
## Mythic Uniques
---

**Ring of Starless Skies** adds damage to all of your abilities after you spend primary resources. 

**Found a Mythic and want to know if it's useable?** [Is this Mythic usable with my build?](https://youtu.be/JGUtZ2TzXso?si=5cgPsJCZ1lJv-3rC)

---
## Chaos Armor
---

### These Chaos Uniques can be found in any slot combination. You do not have to match the planner exactly, you will just need to find all of these in this combination.

- **Fists of Fate** great source of applying **Vulnerable** to enemies. Also a big increase at random to your attacks. 
- **Ramalandi's Magnum Opus** removing this from your weapon slot, adding it into your armor will free up another weapon slot for tempers, it will also add additional damage. It removes having to search for the perfect aspect since that is the most important part of the Ramaladni's. 
- **Rage of Harrogath** adding this on as chaos armor adds increased chance to reset your cooldowns, which will allow you to not have the **Ugly Bastard Helmet** on and still maintain 100% up-time on **Wrath of the Berserker**
- **Gohr's Devastating Grips** gains extra damage, and since this is a big source of your damage spikes it's an important piece for the Chaos Armor
**Battle Trance** plays a big role in the build. It adds +30% all resistances and it has a lucky hit chance to apply frenzy stacks even if frenzy isn't on your bar. While you're at max stacks you're going to gain increased damage.
